as_told.title: Ambush with shots fired on the next mission

plain: Jake Barber, a former military helicopter pilot who says he took part in secret missions to retrieve UFOs, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about a later mission. He says that on that next mission shots were fired, and in a second interview he calls it an ambush. If true, it would mean these recovery missions were met with armed resistance.
